title: Northgate Card Holds on Recent Outside Merchant Credits Before a Credit Balance Refund
content:
Merchant credits from merchants other than Northgate that posted to a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account in the last month can be held when the cardholder asks for a credit balance refund.

A merchant credit names the purchase it credits by that purchase's reference, and an unreferenced merchant credit is one whose purchase reference is empty. The account's payment record is clean when no payment was returned unpaid in the last 12 months.

**Merchant credit hold.** The merchant credit hold follows the account's payment record and the merchant credits posted in the last month:

- where the payment record is not clean, every merchant credit posted in the last month by a merchant other than Northgate is held;
- where it is clean and an unreferenced merchant credit was posted in the last month by a merchant other than Northgate, those unreferenced credits are held;
- in every other case nothing is held.

A held merchant credit is released once a month has passed from its posting date. The last month takes the entries dated after the same calendar day one month before today; the last 12 months the entries dated after the same calendar day 12 months before today.

| Payment record | Outside merchant credits in the last month | Held |
|---|---|---|
| not clean | any | all of them |
| clean | one or more unreferenced | the unreferenced ones |
| clean | only referenced ones, or none | nothing |
| any | Northgate credits only | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases.** Clean record; an outside credit of 64.00 naming its purchase and an unreferenced outside credit of 22.50, both posted in the last month: 22.50 is held. The same credits on an account with a payment returned 3 months ago: 86.50 is held.
